user.title: Choose authentication
user.description: SMS login and cloud MQTT reads/reconnects were verified with two Q360T5-Pro devices. This remains a beta; existing-token setup is retained. Opening the menu sends no SMS.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize AUPU
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new account token for the same device. REST replaces its token; MQTT obtains replacement cached credentials without retaining the account token. Existing entities are preserved.

mqtt.title: MQTT and LAN verification
mqtt.description: Enter this heater's LAN IPv4 and MAC. HA must be able to receive ICMP replies and read its LAN neighbor MAC. Setup verifies identity and MQTT state without device commands. Keep the IP stable. MQTT still uses AUPU Cloud; credential lifetime testing is incomplete.

token.title: Connect AUPU bathroom heater
token.description: Choose REST or experimental MQTT. An account token is needed for initial discovery. MQTT stores connection credentials and the device LAN IP/MAC; runtime does not use the account token. Long-term credential validity is still being verified.

sms.title: SMS login (experimental)
sms.description: Use the mainland China phone bound to your AUPU account. Submitting requests one SMS, without automatic retries. MQTT setup does not persist your phone, code or account token; REST retains the account token.

sms_code.title: Enter verification code
sms_code.description: Enter the six-digit code. The local flow expires after ten minutes and permits five login attempts. A request timeout may still have delivered the SMS.

reauth.title: Reauthorize AUPU
reauth.description: Ordinary reconnects reuse cached MQTT credentials. Reauthenticate when credentials are rejected.

error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or expired.
error.wrong_account: This account cannot access the configured device.
error.invalid_local_identity: Enter a valid private IPv4 address and unicast MAC.
error.cannot_verify_mqtt: Cannot verify LAN reachability, expected MAC and MQTT state. Check the addresses, network and credentials.
error.icmp_unreachable: HA received no ICMP reply from the heater.
error.neighbor_missing: HA could not read the device neighbor MAC; direct LAN access is required.
error.neighbor_mismatch: The IP address has a different MAC than expected.
error.local_probe_error: HA could not execute the LAN check; see the safe error type in its integration log.
error.invalid_phone: Enter an 11-digit mainland China mobile number.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait at least 60 seconds after the last request and check your phone.
error.cannot_send_sms: SMS request rejected; no automatic retry.
error.sms_delivery_uncertain: Delivery is uncertain. Enter the code if it arrived; it was not resent.
error.sms_login_rejected: SMS login rejected. Check your code and account.

abort.no_devices: No supported AUPU bathroom heater found.
abort.sms_flow_expired: The local ten-minute login window expired.
abort.sms_attempts_exhausted: This login flow has exhausted its attempts.
